tools.name: scan_url
tools.description:
Scan a single URL for phishing or malware risk.

    Args:
        url: The URL to scan.
        temperature: Optional decision threshold from 0.0 to 1.0. Higher is
            stricter; when omitted the service default is used.

tools.name: scan_urls
tools.description:
Scan several URLs in one request.

    Args:
        urls: The URLs to scan.
        temperature: Optional decision threshold from 0.0 to 1.0. Higher is
            stricter; when omitted the service default is used.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description:
Return this account's monthly usage and remaining plan allowance.

    Args:
        year: Four-digit UTC year; defaults to the current year.
        month: UTC month from 1 to 12; defaults to the current month.
